messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Never give your Adderall to anyone else, because Adderall may cause death or harm them.
Selling or giving away Adderall is against the law.
Adderall may also be used for purposes not listed in this medication guide.
Adderall (mixed amphetamine and dextroamphetamine salts) was FDA-approved on January 19, 1960.
Extended-release formulations of Adderall (Adderall XR) are only used to treat ADHD.
Triplet: ["Adderall", "may be used for", "purposes not listed in medication guide"]

The relation 'may be used for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'has administration instruction': The subject drug should be taken or used in the manner specified by the object entity (for example with food or at a fixed time).
C. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
E. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
